concerns.text: data-model.md says generalization_metrics.json contains `baseline_mape`, `relative_mape_reduction`, and SC-002 pass/fail, but results_schema.schema.yaml (additionalProperties: false) defines none of these fields. FR-004/SC-002's required measurement has no valid contract; the implementer cannot emit the baseline comparison without violating the schema.

data-model.md §4.4 defines predictions.json (material_id, family, true/pred Young/shear/Poisson, absolute errors, per-record APE), but predictions.schema.yaml is a CSV-row schema with different fields (error_young, mape_young only, no shear/poisson errors). Deliverable 10 has two contradictory contracts; FR-004/SC-002 evaluation depends on this file.

Quickstep step 4 runs `python code/utils/verify_success_criteria.py --input data/results/generalization_metrics.json`, but this script appears nowhere in the plan's Project Structure or task list — an unbacked plan element with no FR/SC anchor. Either add a task or remove the step.

Constitution Principle VI states the surrogate accuracy claim is '≤15% MAPE' evaluated on held-out families, but the plan only gates SC-002 (≥10% relative MAPE reduction) and never measures or reports an absolute MAPE threshold. results_schema.schema.yaml even carries a `threshold (e.g., 0.15)` field the plan never populates. Pin this to a spec/constitution decision or drop the unused threshold field.
